newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo in pact with Japan's Takeda.
newsitem.headline: Novo in pact with Japan's Takeda.

text.p: Danish biotechnology and pharmaceuticals group Novo Nordisk said on Tuesday it signed an agreement with Japan's Takeda Chemical Industries to cooperate on diabetes research.

Novo, the leading world producer of insulin, said in a statement that the aim of the deal was primarily to develop new and better orally active drugs to control blood glucose levels in patients suffering from type two diabetes.
It said research costs would be shared equally by the two firms, with no up-front payment or milestone payments involved. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
